verdict.rationale: Superhuman's docs say users are automatically reminded to follow up when an email needs a response, with a nudge draft ready, which covers the follow-up-reminder half of the story. Nothing in the evidence documents snoozing conversations. It is also unclear whether the reminder resurfaces the thread in the inbox or only prompts a nudge. missing for 10: any snooze capability, explicit documentation that reminders resurface the thread when nobody replies, user-configurable reminder timing, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can snooze conversations and set follow-up reminders that resurface a thread if nobody replies

citations.quote: If your email needs a response, you’re automatically reminded to follow up—with a draft already written and ready to send.
Get an email assistant that automatically labels incoming emails, archives low-priority messages, drafts replies, and reminds you to follow up.
Handle every follow-up with one prompt. Superhuman Mail can check which emails have been read, draft all the nudges, and send when each recipient is most likely to open it.
